jobs.title: Manager Strategy and Partnerships
jobs.description:
Role Overview:
The Manager - Strategy and Partnerships will support PSEB's international market development, strategic partnerships and export promotion agenda to increase Pakistan's IT & IT-Enabled Services (ITeS) exports. The position will focus on identifying international buyers and partners, preparing and executing country-specific market plans, developing qualified commercial opportunities and tracking outcomes throughout the year. The Manager will work with Pakistani IT companies, foreign missions, Trade & Investment Counsellors (TICs), diaspora networks, industry associations, development partners and international organizations. This is a market development and partnerships role, distinct from the logistical delivery of events and delegations. The role reports to the Director, Business Development & Partnerships.
Educational Qualification:
Minimum 16 years of education in Business Administration, Marketing, International Relations, Economics, Management, Public Policy or a related field.
Candidates from other academic disciplines with relevant professional experience directly related to the experience requirements and responsibilities of this role are also encouraged to apply.
Degree(s) must be from a HEC-recognized national or international university/institution.
Experience:
Minimum 10 years of total professional experience, including at least 05 years of relevant post-qualification experience in business development, strategic partnerships, corporate strategy, international trade, market development, management consulting, account management, client relations or related functions.
Experience gained in the private sector, public institutions or other industries will be considered based on relevant transferable skills. Experience working with government institutions or public-sector organizations will be preferred but not mandatory.
Demonstrated ability in relationship development, market analysis, negotiation, stakeholder management and commercial opportunity development is required.
Experience in IT & ITeS, export promotion, international client engagement or B2B/G2B/G2G engagements will be considered an advantage, not a mandatory requirement.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategy & Market Development
Support the Director, Business Development & Partnerships in developing and independently executing approved country-specific market development, partnership and export promotion plans, with defined priorities, stakeholders and timelines.
